title: 莉莉娅·梦花小园
description: 鹿身莉莉娅轻低头照看花盆，紫粉卷发和树枝状角保留，花杖安静倚靠一侧。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Lillia is a gentle fae deer being with a young feminine upper body, large deer ears, soft branching antlers, lavender-pink hair, and a warm brown four-legged deer body. Preserve her shy wide-eyed face and leaflike ornaments while clothing the upper torso fully in an opaque long-sleeved lilac tunic. Her curved wooden flower staff leans safely on a support, not swung or casting sleep spells.
art_direction.scene: She bends her upper body slightly beside a low flower stand and uses both hands to turn a little blooming pot toward the light. All four deer legs remain grounded and readable, with her tail visible. A rounded tree and two tiny mushrooms create a bright woodland nook, emphasizing gentle curiosity instead of hiding or fear.
art_direction.palette: lavender pink, warm fawn brown, leaf green, peach
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
